semantic_adjudication.reason: The NL requires the sub-machine to become active upon collision detection. The G1 predicate (may_reach) returned verdict=false with an exact counterexample showing no path from the root initial (UnspecifiedInitial) to any descendant of Collision_Avoidance_Active_Mode. The complete 7-transition inventory confirms no transition targets the composite from any root-scope source. The root's only initial transition targets UnspecifiedInitial, a synthetic leaf with no outgoing transitions. This wording directly supports an event-driven entry reading: the collision detection event IS the activation mechanism. The model's conditional initial entries (triggered by collision_detected) are a direct semantic implementation of the NL's stated activation condition. The NL does not independently require an unconditional default entry state; it requires the sub-machine to become active upon detection, which the conditional entries achieve semantically (in principle).
